🧹 Nitpick comments (1)
test/bootstrap_test.cljs (1)
`17-18`: **📐 Maintainability & Code Quality** | **🔵 Trivial** | **⚡ Quick win** **Use distinct gitlink revisions and assert the plan by path.** `bootstrap/plan` looks up each revision by source path. Because the fixture and expected plan assign `child-sha` to every child, a planner that copies one gitlink revision to all children can still pass. Give at least two paths different revisions, then compare the fixture’s path-to-revision mapping with the planned mapping.
Suggested test change ```diff (def other-sha (apply str (repeat 40 "c"))) +(defn child-revision [path] + (if (= ".agents" path) other-sha child-sha)) + (def input {:bootstrap/root-revision root-sha :bootstrap/project project/project :bootstrap/manifest (project/gitmodule-declarations) :bootstrap/gitlinks - (mapv (fn [source] {:path (:source/path source) :mode "160000" - :revision child-sha}) + (mapv (fn [source] {:path (:source/path source) :mode "160000" + :revision (child-revision (:source/path source))}) (project/submodule-sources))}) @@ (assoc (select-keys source [:source/id :source/path :source/repository]) - :source/revision child-sha + :source/revision (child-revision (:source/path source)) :source/actionable? (boolean (:source/actionable? source)) :source/consolidation? (boolean (:source/consolidation? source)))) @@ - (is (every? #(= child-sha (:source/revision %)) children)) + (is (= #{child-sha other-sha} + (set (map :revision (:bootstrap/gitlinks input))))) + (is (= (into {} (map (juxt :path :revision) (:bootstrap/gitlinks input))) + (into {} (map (juxt :source/path :source/revision) children)))) ```

Replace the uniform revision assertion with a comparison of the fixture’s path-to-revision mapping against the planned children’s mapping from `bootstrap/plan`. ```
